task_instance: Decision-grade dossier on Cloudflare, Inc. Ran self-answered Phase 1 intake (subject/type/purpose/hypothesis/brief-depth), 5 WebSearch queries with supporting/disconfirming classification (40% disconfirming), tiered citations, and generated a 9-section .docx via Node.js docx package.
